titleZh: 系統停止運作或安排失效

brief.meaningEn: Stop working or functioning as intended, of a system, process or machine.
brief.meaningZh: 系統、程序或機器不再按原定方式運作。
brief.grammar: the system breaks down; broke/has broken down; this lesson uses the stop-functioning sense, not analyse into parts or become emotionally overwhelmed.
brief.register: Common phrasal verb. Name the function that failed rather than treating any delay or changed plan as a breakdown.
brief.boundaryZh: 失效可暫時或局部，不保證永久不能修，也不代表機器必碎裂；要交代哪項功能停止。
brief.misconceptionZh: 紙本後備可讓工作繼續，同時原系統仍失效；不能因有替代便否定故障。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述功能失效及後備安排，分清故障與結果。

sources.sentence: Problems grow when communication breaks down.

listening.en: The sign-in system broke down when it stopped saving new arrivals, so we used a paper list while a colleague checked the fault.
listening.zh: 登記系統停止儲存新到人員時失效，所以同事查故障期間，我們用紙本名單。
listening.promptZh: 哪項功能失效，怎樣繼續？

options.en: New arrivals were not saved, and a paper list served as a backup.
options.zh: 新到人員未被儲存，紙本名單作後備。

options.en: The team analysed the saved names into smaller categories.
options.zh: 團隊把已存姓名細分種類。

options.en: The digital records already contained the new arrivals, and paper was used only as a duplicate.
options.zh: 電子紀錄已有新到人員，紙本只作副本。

options.en: The colleague had already repaired the fault before any names were missed.
options.zh: 漏姓名前，同事已修故障。

listening.explanationZh: stopped saving是功能失效，用紙本仍可繼續登記，故障仍在查。

reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼改用紙本名單？
reply.promptEn: Why did you switch to a paper list?

options.en: The digital system stopped saving the new arrivals.
options.zh: 電子系統停止儲存新到人員。

options.en: It broke down, so we needed another way to record who arrived.
options.zh: 它失效，所以需另一方法記誰到了。

options.en: We could not rely on the sign-in records being saved.
options.zh: 我們不能依賴登記紀錄會被儲存。

options.en: The paper list let us keep recording people while the fault was checked.
options.zh: 查故障期間，紙本名單讓我們繼續記人。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答失效的功能及後備需要。

scene.promptZh: 自動字幕突然停止顯示新句子，主持人改用預先印好的短摘要，技術人員仍在查。哪句準確？

options.en: The caption system has broken down, so we are using the printed summary for now.
options.zh: 字幕系統失效，所以暫用印本摘要。

options.en: The technicians have already restored every live caption before the summary is used.
options.zh: 用摘要前，技術人員已恢復全部即時字幕。

options.en: The system is splitting each sentence into shorter parts while displaying it correctly.
options.zh: 系統正把每句分短，仍正確顯示。

scene.explanationZh: 停止新字幕是運作失效，不是已恢復或正常分析句子。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像本課 break down？

options.en: A booking system stops processing new requests.
options.zh: 預約系統停止處理新請求。

options.en: A teacher divides a complicated explanation into simpler parts.
options.zh: 老師把複雜說明分為簡單部分。

options.en: A machine can no longer perform its normal function.
options.zh: 機器無法再做正常功能。

contrast.explanationZh: 分解說明是另一用法，不是本課停止運作。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說「紙本還能登記，所以電子系統沒故障」，但新姓名仍存不到。哪句最好？

options.en: The backup keeps registration going; the digital saving function is still not working.
options.zh: 後備讓登記繼續；電子儲存功能仍未可用。

options.en: Using paper means the digital records can now be treated as complete.
options.zh: 使用紙本表示電子紀錄現可當完整。

options.en: We should stop recording arrivals until the original system works, even though the paper list is available.
options.zh: 雖有紙本可用，原系統未好前應停止記抵達。

dialogue.explanationZh: 後備運作與原系統失效可並存，不把紙本當電子已完整，也不用因此停所有記錄。

speaking.en: The system broke down, but a simple backup let the team continue while the fault was checked.
speaking.zh: 系統失效，但查故障期間，簡單後備讓團隊繼續。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指明失效功能及替代。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你在合作故事寫兩個角色本來靠鄰店代傳訊息，鄰店突然關門，訊息一直送不到，令角色誤以為朋友不理自己。你要向編輯說這是傳訊安排失效，想加一幕讓角色找到失訊原因，不寫成朋友故意拒絕。用一至兩句英文解釋修改。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把店關門與傳訊失效連起，提出劇情發現來修正誤會，不把沒收到等同朋友故意拒絕。

examples.en: The message arrangement broke down when the shop closed, rather than because the friend refused to reply. I want to add a scene in which the characters discover why the messages never arrived.
examples.zh: 店關門令傳訊安排失效，不是朋友拒回；我想加一幕讓角色發現訊息為何一直沒到。

examples.en: Their informal communication system has broken down, leaving each person with the wrong impression. A discovery at the closed shop could explain the missing messages without changing the friend’s intentions.
examples.zh: 他們非正式傳訊系統失效，令雙方誤會；在關門店前的發現可解釋失訊，不改朋友意圖。

takeaways.en: The booking process broke down when requests stopped reaching the person who assigned the rooms.
takeaways.zh: 請求不再到分房負責人手上時，預約程序失效。

takeaways.en: A backup plan helps when the usual system breaks down.
takeaways.zh: 平常系統失效時，後備計劃有幫助。

titleZh: 提高要求或標準

brief.meaningEn: Set a higher standard for what is expected or required.
brief.meaningZh: 把預期或要求的標準訂得更高。
brief.grammar: raise the bar for someone/on something; raised in past; identify the new requirement and who must meet it.
brief.register: Established sports metaphor. Raising a standard is distinct from everyone already achieving it or one person improving performance.
brief.boundaryZh: 標準提高不確立達標人數或保證品質，仍需培訓及評估；不等於規則必不合理。
brief.misconceptionZh: 更高要求與已經做得更好不同，可有新目標但未完成。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體前後要求描述提高標準，保留達成情況。

listening.en: The new archive policy raised the bar for captions: each date now needed a named source as well as a location, while the team still had to review older entries.
listening.zh: 新檔案政策提高圖說標準：每個日期現需具名來源及地點，團隊仍需檢視舊條目。
listening.promptZh: 提高的是甚麼，未完成的是甚麼？

options.en: Captions need stronger source information, but older entries still await review.
options.zh: 圖說需更完整來源資訊，舊條目仍待檢視。

options.en: Every old caption already meets the new source requirement.
options.zh: 每個舊圖說已符合新來源要求。

options.en: The policy removes the need to identify where a date came from.
options.zh: 政策取消交代日期出處的需要。

options.en: Only optional style suggestions changed; the evidence requirements stayed the same.
options.zh: 只改選用的風格建議，證據要求沒變。

listening.explanationZh: 新增具名來源是標準提高，未確立舊條目已達標。

reply.promptZh: 新政策怎樣改圖說要求？
reply.promptEn: How did the new policy change the caption requirements?

options.en: Each date now needs a named source as well as a location.
options.zh: 每個日期現需具名來源及地點。

options.en: It raised the bar by requiring clearer source information.
options.zh: 它要求較清楚來源資訊，提高標準。

options.en: The evidence expected for a caption became more demanding.
options.zh: 圖說所需證據變得要求更高。

options.en: A location alone no longer meets the full caption requirement.
options.zh: 只地點不再符合完整圖說要求。

reply.explanationZh: 四句給新要求，不把提高標準當大家已達成。

scene.promptZh: 演講賽由只評清楚表達，改為也要求說明證據來源；參加者仍在準備。哪句貼切？

options.en: The new rule raises the bar by asking speakers to explain their sources too.
options.zh: 新規則要求講者也解釋來源，提高標準。

options.en: The rule confirms that every speaker has already supplied adequate evidence.
options.zh: 規則確認每位講者已提供足夠證據。

options.en: The competition has stopped considering clear expression.
options.zh: 比賽已停止考慮清楚表達。

scene.explanationZh: 加來源而非取消表達，標準新立不表示參加者已全達成。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 raised the bar 得出？

options.en: The expected standard became higher.
options.zh: 預期標準提高。

options.en: Everyone subject to it has already met that standard.
options.zh: 所有受此要求的人已達該標準。

options.en: Context should show which requirement changed.
options.zh: 情境應交代哪項要求改了。

contrast.explanationZh: 訂高要求與實際達標不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 新政策要求圖說的日期附具名來源及地點，同伴想知道舊條目怎處理；舊條目尚未按新要求核對。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Apply the named-source requirement when reviewing the older captions, as well as when creating new ones.
options.zh: 檢視舊圖說及製作新圖說時，都應按具名來源要求處理。

options.en: Use the new evidence requirement only for future captions and leave the older entries outside the review.
options.zh: 新證據要求只用於之後的圖說，把舊條目排除於檢視。

options.en: Adding a clearer location to each old date should meet the new requirement without identifying its source.
options.zh: 替每個舊日期加較清楚地點，不列來源便應符合新要求。

dialogue.explanationZh: 新要求包括日期具名來源，舊條目仍待按此檢視；不能只適用新稿或以地點代來源。

speaking.en: The change raised the bar for the work, but we still needed evidence that the new requirement was being met.
speaking.zh: 改動提高工作標準，但仍需證據顯示新要求正被符合。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清標準及達標。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你回覆朋友對新錄音徵集的疑問，以前只交故事聲音，現在還需附一段能讓初聽者理解人物背景的簡介。你想解釋標準提高在哪裏，並提議一起試讀簡介，不保證附了便獲選。用一至兩句英文回覆。
writing.selfCheckZh: 明說新增人物背景要求及試讀方法，區分提高標準、確認可讀與最後獲選，不把加頁數當合格保證。

examples.en: The new call raises the bar by asking for context as well as the story recording. We could test our introduction with a first-time listener before submitting it.
examples.zh: 新徵集除故事錄音也要求背景，提高標準；投稿前可找初聽者試簡介。

examples.en: They have raised the bar: the submission now needs a clear introduction to the people in the story. Let us check whether someone new can follow it, rather than assume the extra page guarantees selection.
examples.zh: 他們提高標準：投稿現需清楚介紹故事人物；找新人核能否理解，不假定加一頁便保證入選。

takeaways.en: The revised brief raised the bar by asking for a tested sample rather than a sketch alone.
takeaways.zh: 新要求需試過的樣本，不只草圖，因而提高標準。

takeaways.en: A stronger example can raise the bar for what the rest of the group hopes to produce.
takeaways.zh: 較強示例可提高小組其他人希望製作的標準。

titleZh: 原有基本條件突然改變

brief.meaningEn: The basic circumstances one relies on change unexpectedly.
brief.meaningZh: 原本依賴的基本情況意外改變。
brief.grammar: when the ground shifts beneath them/us; shifted in past; name the assumption or condition that changes.
brief.register: Conventional unstable-ground metaphor. It concerns circumstances rather than necessarily a physical event or a personal failure.
brief.boundaryZh: 條件改變不等於當事人不可靠或計劃永遠不可行；需交代改了甚麼及需重評的部分。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可保留目標但改路徑，不能假定原有安排不需再核。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述根本條件改變及相應重新評估。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Firms need plans for when the ground shifts beneath them.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 28, table 1, row 5; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The ground shifted beneath us when the only venue with evening access changed its opening hours; our plan for after-work classes needed a new location, even though the teaching materials were ready.
listening.zh: 唯一晚間可用場地改開放時間時，我們依賴的基本條件突變；下班後課程需新地點，雖教材已備好。
listening.promptZh: 基本改變影響哪部分？

options.en: Evening access disappeared, so the ready materials still needed a new place to be used.
options.zh: 晚間使用不再可行，所以備好教材仍需新地方用。

options.en: The teaching content needed rewriting, while the evening venue remained available.
options.zh: 教學內容需重寫，但晚間場地仍可用。

options.en: The old evening access remained available throughout the planning.
options.zh: 規劃期間，原有晚間使用一直可行。

options.en: The team had already arranged a replacement before hearing about the changed hours.
options.zh: 聽到改時間前，團隊已安排替代地點。

listening.explanationZh: 條件是晚間場地，不是教材內容失真；新地點仍需找。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼備好教材仍需重排？
reply.promptEn: Why did the ready materials not mean the plan could proceed unchanged?

options.en: The venue’s new hours no longer allowed the planned evening classes.
options.zh: 場地新時間不再容許原定晚課。

options.en: The ground shifted beneath us when evening access changed.
options.zh: 晚間使用改時，我們原依賴的條件突然變了。

options.en: A basic location assumption was no longer valid.
options.zh: 基本地點假設不再成立。

options.en: The class plan depended on access that the venue could no longer provide.
options.zh: 課程依賴場地不能再提供的使用時間。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給關鍵場地條件改變。

scene.promptZh: 你與朋友原約以家中客房作交換住宿，但屋主決定整季維修，兩人現需重談住宿方式；旅程目的仍在。哪句準確？

options.en: The ground has shifted beneath us: the room we relied on is no longer available.
options.zh: 我們依賴的條件變了：原本靠的房不再可用。

options.en: The repairs will finish before the visit, so the original room remains available.
options.zh: 維修會在到訪前完成，所以原房間仍可用。

options.en: Changing the room means the purpose of the trip has already disappeared.
options.zh: 改房表示旅程目的已消失。

scene.explanationZh: 基本住宿條件變需重談，不等於原安排仍在或目的全無。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 the ground shifted beneath them 的比喻？

options.en: A crucial condition changes and the plan needs reassessment.
options.zh: 關鍵條件改，計劃需重評。

options.en: The underlying conditions remain the same while a spelling mistake is corrected.
options.zh: 基本條件沒變，只改拼字錯。

options.en: A previously reliable assumption no longer fits the situation.
options.zh: 原可靠假設不再合情況。

contrast.explanationZh: 小修措辭並無基本條件轉變。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說教材好了就沿用晚間地點，不用理新開放時間；你知已不能晚用。哪句最好？

options.en: The materials are ready, but the access condition has changed; we need to check a new location.
options.zh: 教材備好，但使用條件已改；需核新地點。

options.en: The changed hours affect daytime classes, while our evening access remains available.
options.zh: 改時間影響日間課，而我們的晚間使用仍可行。

options.en: We should discard the materials rather than reconsider where the class could meet.
options.zh: 應丟教材，不必重想課程可在哪聚。

dialogue.explanationZh: 教材與場地各有狀態，需重排地點而非以一項代另一項或全丟。

speaking.en: The ground shifted beneath us, so we had to revisit the assumption the plan depended on.
speaking.zh: 我們依賴的條件突然變了，所以需重看計劃所依靠的假設。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出基本條件。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫人物回憶，一位學徒原以為能跟老師傅完成整季木工，師傅卻突然搬城；學徒仍想學，正找可定期視訊及本地練習的安排。你要用兩句英文描寫條件突變及仍在探索的下一步，不寫成已學會。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以師傅搬走描述原學徒安排突變，保留想學與探索後備，未把願望或探索說成已掌握技巧。

examples.en: The ground shifted beneath me when my teacher moved away halfway through the apprenticeship. I still wanted to learn, so I began looking for local practice and a way to speak with him regularly.
examples.zh: 學徒期中途老師搬走，我依賴的條件突然變了；我仍想學，所以開始找本地練習及定期跟他談的方法。

examples.en: When the teacher left town, the ground shifted beneath her, but her wish to learn remained. She was exploring video calls and local practice rather than pretending the original arrangement still existed.
examples.zh: 老師離城時，她依賴的條件變了，但學習意願仍在；她正探索視訊及本地練習，不假裝原安排仍存在。

takeaways.en: The ground shifted beneath them when the rules governing the project changed.
takeaways.zh: 規管項目的規則改時，他們依賴的基本條件突然變了。

takeaways.en: We need a plan for responding when the ground shifts beneath us, rather than assume the starting conditions will last.
takeaways.zh: 我們需計劃怎樣回應基本條件突變，不假定起步條件一直維持。

titleZh: 隨勢漂流，沒有主動選方向

brief.meaningEn: Let surrounding events or trends determine one’s direction without making deliberate choices.
brief.meaningZh: 讓周圍事件或潮流決定方向，沒有主動選擇。
brief.grammar: simply drift with the tide; drifting/drifted; identify which outside influence replaces a considered decision.
brief.register: Conventional sea-current metaphor, critical when used about passive decision-making. Responding to evidence is not necessarily passive drifting.
brief.boundaryZh: 按新資料調整可有主動判斷，不能把所有改動都叫隨波逐流；需看有否檢視目的及選項。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不盲跟潮流也不表示拒所有新想法，可按目的選擇採用。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清主動調整與由外界自動決定方向。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A leader cannot simply drift with the tide.

listening.en: The reading club had been drifting with the tide, choosing whatever title was trending that week without asking what members wanted to explore; we decided to discuss a purpose before the next selection.
listening.zh: 讀書會一直隨波逐流，當周甚麼書熱門就選甚麼，沒問成員想探索甚麼；我們決定下次選書前先談目的。
listening.promptZh: 隨勢漂流的依據及下一步是甚麼？

options.en: Trends replaced discussion of purpose, so the club would discuss its aims before choosing again.
options.zh: 潮流取代目的討論，所以社團下次選前先談目標。

options.en: Members compared titles against an agreed aim before every choice.
options.zh: 成員每次都按議定目的比較書目。

options.en: The club had decided to reject every new book before hearing from members.
options.zh: 社團未聽成員前，已決定拒每本新書。

options.en: The next title was already selected after the new purpose discussion.
options.zh: 新目的討論後，下次書目已選定。

listening.explanationZh: 只按熱門自動選而未問目的，是被潮流帶着走；討論仍是下一步。

reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼想選書前先談社團目的？
reply.promptEn: Why do you want to discuss the club’s purpose before selecting a book?

options.en: We had been following trends without asking what members wanted to explore.
options.zh: 我們一直跟潮流，沒問成員想探索甚麼。

options.en: We were drifting with the tide rather than choosing from a clear aim.
options.zh: 我們在隨勢漂流，而非按清楚目標選。

options.en: The popular title of the week had become our only selection guide.
options.zh: 當周熱門書成了唯一選書依據。

options.en: A purpose discussion would let us make a considered choice instead of an automatic one.
options.zh: 談目的可讓我們審慎選，不是自動跟從。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給缺主動目的的理由，不等於新書全不好。

scene.promptZh: 你總按同事周末去哪便跟去哪，從未想自己想做甚麼，現想留一天自己選活動。哪句貼切？

options.en: I have been drifting with the tide instead of choosing how I want to spend the weekend.
options.zh: 我一直隨勢漂流，沒自己選怎過周末。

options.en: I have been comparing the invitations against my own clear priorities each week.
options.zh: 我每周一直按自己清楚優先次序比較邀請。

options.en: I let the first colleague who replies choose my day, and count that as deciding my own priorities.
options.zh: 我讓最先回覆的同事選我的一天，並把這當自己定優先次序。

scene.explanationZh: 未想自己需要便跟從，符合被帶着走；把選擇交給先回覆者，仍未建立自己的優先次序。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像 drift with the tide？

options.en: Following each new trend without considering one’s purpose.
options.zh: 不考慮目的就跟每個新潮流。

options.en: Comparing new evidence with a clear aim and deliberately revising the plan.
options.zh: 按清楚目標比較新證據，主動改計劃。

options.en: Allowing events to decide the direction while avoiding a choice.
options.zh: 迴避選擇，讓事件決定方向。

contrast.explanationZh: 有依據主動改不是被動漂流。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說「不跟潮流，就完全不要新書」，但你只想先按目的選。哪句最好？

options.en: We can consider new books while deciding which ones fit what members want to explore.
options.zh: 可考慮新書，同時判哪些合成員想探索的目的。

options.en: We should keep the list entirely unchanged so no trend can affect us.
options.zh: 應保持書單完全不變，讓潮流不能影響。

options.en: The week’s popularity ranking should remain the only basis for our choice.
options.zh: 當周人氣排名應繼續是唯一選擇基礎。

dialogue.explanationZh: 主動選可接納新想法，不必全不變或只跟人氣。

speaking.en: We should not simply drift with the tide when we can discuss the direction we actually want to take.
speaking.zh: 可討論真正想走的方向時，我們不應只是隨勢漂流。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再說主動選擇的方向。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你在社區小額活動籌備會，每次有人熱烈提議便全組換方向，未看附近居民真正需要。你想發一則會前訊息，請先收三項具體需要，再一起選一個本月可做的目標；不禁止新想法。用一至兩句英文提議。

examples.en: We have been drifting with the tide, changing direction with each enthusiastic suggestion. Could we collect three concrete local needs and choose one achievable goal for this month?
examples.zh: 我們一直隨勢漂流，每有熱烈建議便換方向；可否先收三項具體本地需要，再選一個本月可做的目標？

examples.en: I do not want us to drift with the tide when planning the neighbourhood activity. Let us hear new ideas, but compare them with residents’ needs before agreeing on a goal.
examples.zh: 我不想規劃鄰里活動時隨勢漂流；我們聽新想法，但定目標前先跟居民需要比較吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出換方向而未看需要的被動安排，邀先收本地需要再選可做目標，不把有主見等同拒聽新想法。

takeaways.en: The group drifted with the tide until someone asked what the next activity was meant to achieve.
takeaways.zh: 有人問下次活動想達甚麼前，小組一直隨勢漂流。

takeaways.en: We can respond to change without drifting with the tide if we keep reviewing our purpose.
takeaways.zh: 若持續檢視目的，我們可回應改變而不隨勢漂流。

titleZh: 現在到了需要趕緊表現的關頭

brief.meaningEn: The situation now demands performance or a response, often urgently.
brief.meaningZh: 情況現要求作出表現或回應，往往有迫切性。
brief.grammar: the pressure is on to + verb; the pressure was on in past; specify the deadline, expectations or event making the demand immediate.
brief.register: Established spoken expression. It foregrounds the demand now applying, while under pressure more generally describes demanding circumstances.
brief.boundaryZh: 壓力已臨不代表必失敗、必慌亂或結果已完成；需交代時點及實際需要。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可在緊迫下核優先次序，不從需要快便推出可猜資料。
brief.outcomeZh: 能自然表達當前迫切要求，保留核對與未定結果。

sources.sentence: The pressure is on before the final presentation.

listening.en: The submission window closes tomorrow, so the pressure is on to check our last two sources; the draft is written, but we should not fill the missing references from memory.
listening.zh: 投稿窗口明天關，所以現迫切需要核最後兩個來源；草稿已寫，但不應憑記憶補缺引文。
listening.promptZh: 迫切的是哪項未完工作？

options.en: Checking the last two sources before tomorrow’s deadline.
options.zh: 明天期限前核最後兩個來源。

options.en: Starting an entirely unwritten draft after the window has closed.
options.zh: 窗口關後才開始完全未寫的草稿。

options.en: Replacing source checks with remembered references because the draft is finished.
options.zh: 因草稿已寫，改用記憶代來源核對。

options.en: Confirming the submission had already been accepted.
options.zh: 確認投稿已獲接納。

listening.explanationZh: 明天關形成當前壓力，最後來源仍需核，不是已接受或可用記憶填。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你說現在到了緊迫關頭？
reply.promptEn: Why do you say the situation is urgent now?

options.en: The deadline is tomorrow and two sources still need checking.
options.zh: 明天是限期，仍有兩個來源需核。

options.en: The pressure is on to finish the source checks before the window closes.
options.zh: 窗口關前，現迫切需完成來源核對。

options.en: We have little time left to verify the missing references.
options.zh: 剩很少時間核缺引文。

options.en: The written draft cannot go through the final step until those checks are done.
options.zh: 那些核對完成前，已寫草稿不能進最後一步。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給迫切時限及未完工作。

scene.promptZh: 表演十分鐘後開始，兩支咪還需試音；你要提醒大家先處理這項，不是宣布已準備妥。哪句準確？

options.en: The pressure is on to test the microphones before the performance starts.
options.zh: 演出開始前，現在迫切需試咪。

options.en: The performance has already started with both microphones fully checked.
options.zh: 演出已開始，兩咪全核妥。

options.en: The remaining time means sound checks can wait until after the opening song.
options.zh: 餘下時間表示試音可等開場曲後。

scene.explanationZh: 十分鐘及未試咪形成當前要求，不是已核妥或可跳先後。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 the pressure is on 得出？

options.en: There is a present demand to act or perform.
options.zh: 現有行動或表現要求。

options.en: The task has already ended unsuccessfully.
options.zh: 任務已以失敗結束。

options.en: Context can show what makes the demand urgent.
options.zh: 情境可顯示甚麼令要求迫切。

contrast.explanationZh: 緊迫要求不是已定失敗結果。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說「時間少，來源就先靠記憶填」，但最後兩項未核。哪句最好？

options.en: The deadline makes prioritising urgent, not guessing acceptable; let us check those two sources first.
options.zh: 期限令排優先更急，不是可接受猜測；先核那兩個來源吧。

options.en: We should send the draft before doing the source checks, then ask whether corrections can follow tomorrow.
options.zh: 應先寄草稿，再核來源，之後才問明天能否補更正。

options.en: We should spend the remaining time polishing the cover and leave the sources for after submission.
options.zh: 餘下時間應修封面，來源留投稿後才核。

dialogue.explanationZh: 迫切要求先處理尚未核的必要來源，不把核對留到送出後，也不先修封面而延後證據。

speaking.en: The pressure is on, so we need to identify the next essential task rather than guess what remains unchecked.
speaking.zh: 現在要求緊迫，所以需找下一項必要工作，不猜未核內容。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再說當前迫切要求。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你原答應周五交兩張插圖，合作伙伴周四忽然再要一張複雜封面。你知道全做會來不及，想坦白說現在要求緊迫，請對方選擇先收原有兩張，或把封面另訂日期；不假裝全部能如期完成。用一至兩句英文協商。

examples.en: The pressure is on after the extra cover request, and I cannot finish all three pieces by Friday. Could we keep the two agreed illustrations on that date and arrange a separate deadline for the cover?
examples.zh: 加了封面要求後，現在工作緊迫，我不能周五前完三件；可否原定兩張插圖仍按那天交，封面另訂期限？

examples.en: The pressure is on to complete more work than we originally planned. I can deliver the two illustrations on Friday, but I need us to agree on a later date for the new cover.
examples.zh: 現在迫切需完成比原定更多的工作；我可周五交兩張插圖，但需一起議新封面的較後日期。

writing.selfCheckZh: 坦白交代新增工作及可交原有兩張的範圍，請協商新封面日期，不把緊迫寫成已完成或承諾全趕到。

takeaways.en: The pressure is on to prepare the final sample before the judges arrive.
takeaways.zh: 評判到前，現迫切需備最後樣本。

takeaways.en: The pressure was on, but she still asked which details had actually been checked.
takeaways.zh: 當前要求緊迫，但她仍問哪些細節實際已核。

titleZh: 帶領團隊，掌握方向

brief.meaningEn: Direct a group, organisation or shared undertaking through decisions and coordination.
brief.meaningZh: 透過決策及協調，帶領團隊、組織或共同事務。
brief.grammar: steer the ship through + difficulty/towards + goal; steered in past; identify the decision-making role in context. The shared undertaking may also be a household choice rather than a formal organisation. An explicit comparison can use like steering a ship: the indefinite article introduces the ship image, while steer the ship presents the shared undertaking as that ship.
brief.register: Conventional ship metaphor for leadership. The person directing may listen and share work rather than do everything alone.
brief.boundaryZh: 掌方向不代表一人做所有任務、無需意見或能保證結果；需分清帶領與旁觀或只完成個人部分。 明說像駕船時也可用 a ship；仍需由團隊或項目情境判斷比喻，不能只由船字斷定。
brief.misconceptionZh: 共同討論可與有人負責整合決定並存，不因聽意見就沒有帶領者。
brief.outcomeZh: 能具體說明帶領者怎樣協調及掌方向。

listening.en: When the joint exhibition lost its original venue, Lin steered the ship by gathering the teams’ needs, comparing the remaining options and agreeing a new plan with the organisers.
listening.zh: 聯展失去原場地時，蓮收集各隊需要、比較餘下選項，並與主辦者議新計劃，帶領團隊掌方向。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼展現 steered the ship？

options.en: Lin coordinated needs and options to agree a new direction.
options.zh: 蓮協調需要及選項，議定新方向。

options.en: Lin completed only her own labels and left the wider decision untouched.
options.zh: 蓮只完成自己的標籤，沒有處理較大決定。

options.en: The venue had already been replaced before Lin joined the discussion.
options.zh: 蓮加入討論前，場地已被替代。

options.en: Lin avoided the teams’ needs and let the booking order decide the plan.
options.zh: 蓮迴避各隊需要，讓預約次序決定計劃。

listening.explanationZh: 收需要、比選項、議計劃是帶領協調，不是只做個人一份或被安排帶着走。

reply.promptZh: 蓮怎樣帶大家處理場地變動？
reply.promptEn: How did Lin lead the group through the venue change?

options.en: She gathered the teams’ needs and helped agree a new plan.
options.zh: 她收集各隊需要，幫議新計劃。

options.en: She steered the ship by coordinating the options with the organisers.
options.zh: 她與主辦者協調選項，帶領大家掌方向。

options.en: She brought the different requirements into one decision process.
options.zh: 她把不同要求帶入同一決策程序。

options.en: Her role was to guide the shared response rather than handle only her own part.
options.zh: 她的角色是引導共同回應，不只處理自己部分。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答共同決策的帶領方式。

scene.promptZh: 合寫故事各人想法不同，組長先聽理由、整理共同主線，再議誰寫哪段，不是自己代寫全篇。哪句貼切？

options.en: The leader is steering the ship by helping the writers agree on a direction.
options.zh: 組長正幫作者議定方向，帶領團隊。

options.en: The leader has replaced the writers by completing the whole story alone.
options.zh: 組長已獨自完成全篇，取代作者。

options.en: The writers are still waiting for the leader to consider any common direction.
options.zh: 作者仍等組長考慮任何共同方向。

scene.explanationZh: 整合主線及分工顯示帶領，不等於代寫全篇或尚未考慮。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 steer the ship 的帶領意思？

options.en: Coordinate a shared response and make the direction clear.
options.zh: 協調共同回應，說清方向。

options.en: Complete an isolated assigned task without taking part in the wider decisions.
options.zh: 完成孤立的指定任務，沒參與較大決定。

options.en: Guide a group through choices while listening to relevant concerns.
options.zh: 聽相關顧慮，同時引導小組作選擇。

contrast.explanationZh: 只做個人任務未展現掌整體方向。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說蓮聽了各隊意見，所以不能算帶領；但她也整合選項議計劃。哪句最好？

options.en: Listening can be part of leadership; she still coordinated the shared decision.
options.zh: 聆聽可屬帶領一部分；她仍協調共同決定。

options.en: Taking advice means she should be recorded only as an observer.
options.zh: 聽意見表示應只把她記作旁觀者。

options.en: She needs to do every team’s task herself before we can describe her as leading.
options.zh: 需自己做每隊任務，才可形容她帶領。

dialogue.explanationZh: 帶領可協調並聽意見，不只旁觀，也不需一人全做。

speaking.en: She steered the ship by bringing the different concerns into a plan the group could follow.
speaking.zh: 她把不同顧慮整合成小組可跟的計劃，帶領大家掌方向。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再用具體協調說帶領。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：家中有人要夜班休息，有人要練樂器，原本常因共用房間爭執。姐姐聽完作息、畫出安靜時段及可用其他空間，幫大家試一周安排。你想發訊息感謝她帶領這次協調，並提議一周後再問大家是否合用。用一至兩句英文寫謝意及後續。

examples.en: You steered the ship by listening to our different routines and helping us try a workable room-sharing plan. Thank you; could we ask everyone how it feels after a week?
examples.zh: 你聽我們不同作息，幫試可行的共用房間安排，帶領大家掌方向；謝謝你，一周後可問各人感受嗎？

examples.en: Thank you for steering the ship through the disagreement about rest and music practice. The quiet hours give us something concrete to try, and I would like us to review them together next week.
examples.zh: 謝謝你帶領大家處理休息與練樂器的分歧；安靜時段給我們具體安排可試，我希望下周一起檢視。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以聽作息及安排安靜時段感謝實際協調，邀一周後共同檢視，不把試行說成所有需要已永久解決。

takeaways.en: The coordinator steered the ship through a difficult change while keeping the teams informed.
takeaways.zh: 統籌在困難變動中帶領團隊，同時讓各隊知情。

takeaways.en: Someone needs to steer the ship, but that does not mean doing every job alone.
takeaways.zh: 需有人帶領掌方向，但不表示獨自做每項工作。

titleZh: 只顧眼前，忽略後續影響

brief.meaningEn: Failing to consider consequences or needs beyond the immediate situation.
brief.meaningZh: 沒有考慮眼前情況以外的後果或需要。
brief.grammar: a short-sighted decision; be short-sighted to + verb; explain the later consequence being neglected.
brief.register: Conventional vision metaphor, figurative here. Criticism of the decision’s time horizon is distinct from literal eyesight or general intelligence.
brief.boundaryZh: 需有被忽略的後續影響，不只是說話者不同意；也不表示任何短期目標都不好。
brief.misconceptionZh: 當下省時間未必長遠合適，可同時顧即時需要及之後交接。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體後果支持短視評價，不只貼負面標籤。

listening.en: It would be short-sighted to skip the handover notes just to finish earlier today, because next week’s volunteers would have to reconstruct the whole process from memory.
listening.zh: 只為今天早點完就省交接筆記會很短視，因下周義工需憑記憶重組整個程序。
listening.promptZh: 哪個後續影響被提醒？

options.en: Later volunteers would lose the information needed to continue the work.
options.zh: 後來義工會失去繼續工作所需資料。

options.en: The current volunteers had already written complete notes for next week.
options.zh: 本次義工已為下周寫完整筆記。

options.en: The notes matter only to today’s workers, not to the volunteers taking over next week.
options.zh: 筆記只對今天工作的人重要，與下周接手義工無關。

options.en: The next team had agreed not to use any handover information.
options.zh: 下一隊已同意不用任何交接資料。

listening.explanationZh: 今天省時可能令下周義工需憑記憶重組流程；交接筆記的作用正包括後來接手的人。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼省交接筆記會短視？
reply.promptEn: Why would skipping the handover notes be a poor longer-term decision?

options.en: Next week’s volunteers would have to rebuild the process without the information.
options.zh: 下周義工沒資料便需重組程序。

options.en: It would be short-sighted because today’s time saving creates a larger handover problem later.
options.zh: 那會很短視，因今天省時會造成之後更大交接問題。

options.en: Finishing earlier today would leave the next team guessing.
options.zh: 今天早完會讓下一隊猜。

options.en: The decision considers the immediate finish but neglects what the later volunteers need.
options.zh: 決定考慮立即收工，卻忽略後來義工需要。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給被忽略的後續影響。

scene.promptZh: 你們為省今天幾分鐘，把借物標籤丟掉，卻明知下周需靠它們歸還給物主。哪句貼切？

options.en: Throwing the labels away would be short-sighted given next week’s returns.
options.zh: 想到下周歸還，丟標籤會很短視。

options.en: The decision already accounts for how the owners will identify the returned items next week.
options.zh: 決定已照顧物主下周怎辨識還物。

options.en: The labels are being kept as part of the agreed return process.
options.zh: 標籤正保留作議定歸還程序一部分。

scene.explanationZh: 省幾分鐘但之後還物需標籤，是後續需要被忽略，不是已保留或已處理。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 short-sighted 的比喻？

options.en: A quick saving creates a foreseeable problem that was ignored.
options.zh: 快速節省造成可預見卻被忽略的問題。

options.en: A short-term step is chosen after checking and accommodating its later effects.
options.zh: 核並照顧後續影響後，選一項短期步驟。

options.en: A decision overlooks the next group’s need for the information.
options.zh: 決定忽略下一組對資料的需要。

contrast.explanationZh: 短期本身不是短視，關鍵是否忽略後續。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說只要能早收工就是好決定，不用管下周重做；你想評完整影響。哪句最好？

options.en: Count the later handover work too, rather than judge only today’s finish time.
options.zh: 也計之後交接工作，不只按今天收工時間判斷。

options.en: Today’s saved minutes are enough to judge the decision without considering the next team.
options.zh: 今天省的分鐘數已足以判決定，不需考慮下一隊。

options.en: If the notes take time, they should be treated as optional regardless of who needs them later.
options.zh: 若寫筆記花時間，就應當選做，不論之後誰需用。

dialogue.explanationZh: 評當下與後續，不只以今天省時判好壞。

speaking.en: It would be short-sighted to judge the choice only by what it saves us today.
speaking.zh: 只按今天省了甚麼來評選擇，會很短視。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再交代後續影響。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替社團挑新主持，同伴只想選今天說得最大聲的人，忽略幾位願意受訓、會細聽嘉賓的人。你想有禮提議把之後培訓與合作需要也納入，不直接說較安靜者必較好。用一至兩句英文回應。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以培訓發展及後續嘉賓合作說明不能只看當天音量，不把短視評價變任何安靜者都較好。

examples.en: It would be short-sighted to choose only the loudest voice today without considering how people could develop through training. Let us also look at listening and willingness to learn.
examples.zh: 不考慮培訓發展、只選今天最大聲的人，會很短視；也看聆聽及願學吧。

examples.en: A choice based only on today’s confidence could be short-sighted if we ignore the host’s future work with guests. We should consider how each person listens and responds, not just their volume.
examples.zh: 若忽略主持日後跟嘉賓合作，只按今天自信選可能短視；應看各人怎聽及回應，不只音量。

glossary.zh: 日後跟嘉賓合作的工作

takeaways.en: The editor called it short-sighted to save space by removing the explanation new readers would need.
takeaways.zh: 編輯認為為省版位刪去新讀者所需說明很短視。

takeaways.en: A short-sighted plan can meet today’s deadline while leaving tomorrow’s team with an avoidable problem.
takeaways.zh: 短視計劃可趕今天限期，卻給明天團隊留下可避免問題。

titleZh: 懷着希望，盼有好運

brief.meaningEn: Hoping for a favourable outcome while recognising it is uncertain.
brief.meaningZh: 在結果未定時，希望有好結果。
brief.grammar: submit/wait with fingers crossed; with our/their fingers crossed; gesture wording functions as a hope expression.
brief.register: Established informal gesture idiom. It does not itself mean a literal gesture occurred or that preparation was absent.
brief.boundaryZh: 盼好運不等於有保證、已獲批或完全沒準備；要保留願望與已知結果的分別。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可準備充分仍帶希望等結果，不把希望當證據。
brief.outcomeZh: 能自然表達期待並忠於結果未知。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: We submitted the application with fingers crossed.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 29, table 1, row 2; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: We sent the completed proposal with fingers crossed, knowing the panel still had to compare it with the others; our checks were done, but the selection was not ours to make.
listening.zh: 我們把完成提案懷着希望寄出，知道評審仍需與其他比較；核對做了，但入選不是由我們決定。
listening.promptZh: 這裏表示哪種狀態？

options.en: The proposal was ready and sent, while the team hoped for an uncertain selection result.
options.zh: 提案備好已寄，團隊期待未定選拔結果。

options.en: The panel had already confirmed the proposal’s selection.
options.zh: 評審已確認提案入選。

options.en: The team had deliberately sent an unchecked draft and relied only on luck.
options.zh: 團隊刻意寄未核草稿，只靠運氣。

options.en: The team was still preparing to send the proposal, and the panel had not received it.
options.zh: 團隊仍在準備寄提案，評審尚未收到。

listening.explanationZh: completed/checksdone保留準備，still compare及not ours保留未知選拔。

reply.promptZh: 提案寄出時，你們有甚麼期待？
reply.promptEn: What were you hoping for when you sent the proposal?

options.en: We hoped the panel would choose it, although the comparison was still ahead.
options.zh: 我們希望評審會選它，雖比較仍在後面。

options.en: We sent it with fingers crossed for a favourable result.
options.zh: 我們懷着希望寄出，盼好結果。

options.en: We had done the checks and were waiting hopefully for the decision.
options.zh: 我們做了核對，正懷希望等決定。

options.en: The selection was uncertain, but we wanted it to go well.
options.zh: 入選仍未定，但我們盼順利。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答期待，不把核妥當已獲選。

scene.promptZh: 你已練好試鏡並交錄影，現在等回覆，想說盼好消息但沒有確認。哪句貼切？

options.en: I am waiting with fingers crossed after sending the audition video.
options.zh: 寄試鏡片後，我正懷着希望等候。

options.en: The audition video has already secured the role, according to the reply.
options.zh: 按回覆，試鏡片已確保角色。

options.en: The selection decision came before I submitted the recording.
options.zh: 選拔決定在我提交錄影前已作出。

scene.explanationZh: 已準備及提交錄影，現正期待未定回覆；不是已確保角色，亦不是提交前已決定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 with fingers crossed 得出？

options.en: The speaker hopes things will turn out well.
options.zh: 說話者希望事情有好結果。

options.en: The favourable result has already been guaranteed.
options.zh: 好結果已獲保證。

options.en: The phrase can coexist with careful preparation.
options.zh: 措辭可與仔細準備並存。

contrast.explanationZh: 希望不是保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說「你盼好運，是否其實沒準備？」你們已核妥才寄。哪句最好？

options.en: We prepared carefully and still hope for a decision we cannot control.
options.zh: 我們仔細準備，仍對不能控制的決定懷希望。

options.en: The hopeful wording means the panel has already promised acceptance.
options.zh: 懷希望的措辭表示評審已承諾接納。

options.en: The checks must have been incomplete if we still needed to hope.
options.zh: 若仍需懷希望，核對必定未完整。

dialogue.explanationZh: 準備與未知選拔可並存，盼好不否定準備，也不確立評審承諾。

speaking.en: We sent it with fingers crossed after doing the checks, knowing that the final decision was still open.
speaking.zh: 核妥後我們懷着希望寄出，知道最後決定仍未定。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再保留準備及期待。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你與朋友把修補好的舊收音機交給熟悉器材的人測試，還未有結果。朋友問你感受，你想說盼能再聽到外公收藏的節目，也坦言仍需等實測，不說希望能代檢查。用一至兩句英文回覆。
writing.selfCheckZh: 表達私人期待及想再聽錄音的理由，保留實測未回，不把希望變功能已恢復或不用檢查。

examples.en: I am waiting with fingers crossed because I would love to hear Grandpa’s old programmes on it again. We still need the test result before we know whether the repair worked.
examples.zh: 我正懷希望等，因很想再用它聽外公的舊節目；是否修好仍需測試結果。

examples.en: We handed it over with fingers crossed, hoping the radio could play the recordings again. The person testing it has not yet reported back.
examples.zh: 我們懷希望把收音機交去，盼它可再播錄音；測試者仍未回報。

takeaways.en: She submitted the story with fingers crossed and waited for the editor’s reply.
takeaways.zh: 她懷希望交故事，等編輯回覆。

takeaways.en: We were waiting with our fingers crossed after completing the final rehearsal.
takeaways.zh: 完成最後排練後，我們正懷希望等候。

titleZh: 只在旁邊看，沒有採取行動

brief.meaningEn: Remain an observer without taking action while a problem develops.
brief.meaningZh: 問題發展時只作旁觀者，沒有採取行動。
brief.grammar: stand by and watch + event/clause; stood by and watched in past; by belongs to stand by, and watch specifies the observing action.
brief.register: Natural wording built on stand by in its do-nothing sense. Stand by can also mean be ready or support someone in other constructions; here the context identifies non-intervention.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課是旁觀而不處理，並非隨時候命或支持某人；是否應介入需看角色及情況，不只憑站着的姿勢。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可先核資料再採合適行動，不代表一定要獨自接管整個局面。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述不介入的旁觀，並與有安排的觀察或候命分開。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Learner wording is transparently normalised from supplied stand on deck, whose bare nautical wording does not establish passivity. The exact source remains in provenance. Oxford stand-by lists being present without stopping a problem; no claim that stand on deck is a fixed passive idiom.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Managers cannot just stand on deck during a crisis.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 28, table 2, row 6; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The coordinator refused to stand by and watch the same timetable clash upset both groups again; she asked them for available times and arranged a short discussion.
listening.zh: 統籌不願再只旁觀同樣時間表衝突令兩組不快；她問可用時間，安排短討論。
listening.promptZh: 統籌拒絕甚麼，並做了甚麼？

options.en: She rejected passive observation and began checking possible arrangements.
options.zh: 她拒絕被動旁觀，開始核可能安排。

options.en: She observed silently without contacting either group.
options.zh: 她默默看，沒有聯絡兩組。

options.en: She had already received both groups’ agreement before asking their times.
options.zh: 問時間前，她已獲兩組同意。

options.en: She was waiting under an agreed role while another organiser handled the clash.
options.zh: 她按議定角色候命，由另一主辦者處理衝突。

listening.explanationZh: refused to旁觀之後問時段安排討論，是從不介入轉具體處理；未說已有協議或另有人接。

reply.promptZh: 統籌怎樣回應反覆衝突？
reply.promptEn: How did the coordinator respond to the repeated clash?

options.en: She asked about available times and set up a discussion.
options.zh: 她問可用時間，安排討論。

options.en: She would not stand by and watch the clash repeat without trying to address it.
options.zh: 她不願只旁觀衝突重複而不嘗試處理。

options.en: She moved from observing the problem to gathering information for a response.
options.zh: 她從觀察問題，進到收資料作回應。

options.en: She took a practical first step instead of leaving both groups with the same difficulty.
options.zh: 她採實際第一步，不讓兩組一直面對同樣困難。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答開始處理的態度或具體行動。

scene.promptZh: 小組發現稿上把你的插圖署別人名字，組員明知有待核對，卻只看大家繼續用錯標；你想說他們未採行動，不是在等已安排的編輯回覆。哪句準確？

options.en: They stood by and watched the incorrect credit keep being used.
options.zh: 他們只旁觀錯誤署名繼續被使用。

options.en: They had already asked the editor to check the names and were waiting for the reply.
options.zh: 他們已請編輯核名字，正在等回覆。

options.en: They corrected the credit before anyone used the draft.
options.zh: 任何人用稿前，他們已改署名。

scene.explanationZh: 題目明說未採行動，不是已有核對安排後候回或已更正。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像本課 stand by and watch？

options.en: Observe a developing problem without attempting a response.
options.zh: 看問題發展，卻不嘗試回應。

options.en: Check who is responsible and arrange a concrete response while awaiting confirmation.
options.zh: 核誰負責，並在等確認時安排具體回應。

options.en: Remain passive while a known unresolved issue continues.
options.zh: 已知未解問題繼續時，仍被動旁觀。

contrast.explanationZh: 有具體跟進的等候不同於只旁觀。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說不想只旁觀，所以應代兩組決定新時間，但還未問空檔。哪句最好？

options.en: Taking action can start with asking their times; we do not need to impose an unchecked decision.
options.zh: 行動可從問時間開始，不需強加未核決定。

options.en: If we ask first, we are still only watching and have done nothing useful.
options.zh: 若先問，我們仍只是旁觀，沒做有用事。

options.en: We should announce one time now and only later ask whether either group can attend.
options.zh: 現在應宣布一個時段，稍後才問兩組能否來。

dialogue.explanationZh: 不旁觀不等於獨斷，收資料協調本身是實際回應。

speaking.en: I do not want to stand by and watch the problem continue when I can help arrange a response.
speaking.zh: 我可幫安排回應時，不想只旁觀問題持續。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清旁觀及實際跟進。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友在社區會議幾次舉手都未獲發言，意見一直沒進入討論。你想發訊息表明不願只旁觀，願下次向主持請求一輪公平發言，也先問朋友是否希望你這樣幫；不替他說出未問過的要求。用一至兩句英文提出支持。

examples.en: I do not want to stand by and watch your request to speak keep being overlooked. Would you like me to ask the chair for a round in which everyone has a turn?
examples.zh: 我不想只旁觀你發言要求一直被忽略；你想我請主持安排一輪人人有機會說話的環節嗎？

examples.en: I will not just stand by and watch while you struggle to get a hearing, but I want to check what support you would welcome. I could ask for a fair speaking round without presenting your views for you.
examples.zh: 你難以獲聆聽時，我不會只旁觀，但想先問你歡迎甚麼支援；我可請求公平發言一輪，不替你表達看法。

writing.selfCheckZh: 表明願採行動並先問希望，提出向主持請公平發言，不自行代朋友發表意見或強加支援。

takeaways.en: They stood by and watched the disagreement grow without arranging a discussion.
takeaways.zh: 他們只旁觀分歧擴大，沒有安排討論。

takeaways.en: We cannot simply stand by and watch while an avoidable mistake is repeated.
takeaways.zh: 可避免的錯誤反覆出現時，我們不能只是旁觀。

notes: Root-approved meaning-based normalisation: original stand on deck retained exactly in source. Oxford https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/stand-by and Cambridge https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/learner-english/stand-by explicitly attest non-intervention sense. titleZh: 履歷資料看來很出色

brief.meaningEn: Very impressive in written credentials or a formal description, without yet establishing practical performance.
brief.meaningZh: 從書面資格或正式描述看來很出色，尚未確立實際表現。
brief.grammar: an applicant looks/is brilliant on paper; brilliant evaluates written information, while on paper contrasts that view with possible practical experience.
brief.register: Productive adjective frame using conventional on-paper wording. It does not itself assert that the person performs poorly in practice.
brief.boundaryZh: 書面出色可與實際出色並存，也可能有落差；未見實際就不能定好壞或假造資格。
brief.misconceptionZh: 履歷評價不等於觀察教學、協調等實際能力，可設與職責相關的示範。
brief.outcomeZh: 能公平描述書面印象及尚待觀察的部分。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: The supplied guide calls the full wording an idiom. On paper is conventional; brilliant is a productive evaluative adjective. This lesson focuses on person/credentials description rather than claiming every adjective-on-paper frame is a different idiom.

sources.sentence: The applicant looked brilliant on paper.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 29, table 1, row 4; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The applicant looked brilliant on paper.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 194, table 1, row 3; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The applicant looked brilliant on paper, with relevant training and several completed projects, but we had not yet seen how she explained a task to beginners.
listening.zh: 申請者有相關訓練及幾項完成項目，履歷看來很出色，但我們還沒看她怎向初學者解釋任務。
listening.promptZh: 哪些有根據，哪些尚待觀察？

options.en: Her written experience impressed the team; explaining to beginners had not yet been observed.
options.zh: 書面經驗讓團隊印象深；向初學者解釋仍未觀察。

options.en: The team had already watched her teach beginners and found the explanation unclear.
options.zh: 團隊已看她教初學者，覺解釋不清。

options.en: The training and projects were known to be invented.
options.zh: 訓練及項目已知是編造。

options.en: The application contained no relevant experience for the team to assess.
options.zh: 申請沒有相關經驗供團隊評。

listening.explanationZh: 履歷已有相關訓練項目支持正評，實際講解仍未看，不是已不合格或資格假。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼履歷出色後，你們仍想看講解示範？
reply.promptEn: Why do you still want a demonstration after reading the strong application?

options.en: We have not seen how she explains tasks to beginners.
options.zh: 我們還沒看她怎向初學者解釋。

options.en: She is brilliant on paper, but the role also needs an explanation we can observe in practice.
options.zh: 她履歷看來出色，但角色也需可實際觀察的講解。

options.en: The written experience does not show us exactly how she would guide a new learner.
options.zh: 書面經驗沒確切展示她會怎引導新人。

options.en: A relevant demonstration would add evidence beyond the application.
options.zh: 相關示範會加履歷以外的證據。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答未觀察的角色能力，不把示範當已有缺點的證明。

scene.promptZh: 某候選人列多次項目帶領經驗，資料讓你印象深，但你還沒聽他與組員討論；你想保留書面與實際的區別。哪句準確？

options.en: He looks brilliant on paper, though we have not yet observed his group discussion.
options.zh: 他履歷看來很出色，雖然還沒觀察他小組討論。

options.en: His listed projects prove that the discussion has already gone well.
options.zh: 列出的項目證明討論已很順利。

options.en: The lack of an observed discussion confirms that the listed experience is false.
options.zh: 未觀察討論，確認列出經驗是假的。

scene.explanationZh: 資料可受讚，實際討論未看；未看不等於成功已定或資格假。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 brilliant on paper 單獨推斷？

options.en: Written information creates a strong impression.
options.zh: 書面資料帶來很強印象。

options.en: Practical performance has been observed and found poor.
options.zh: 實際表現已被觀察並判為差。

options.en: Further context can compare the credentials with actual work.
options.zh: 更多情境可比較資格與實際工作。

contrast.explanationZh: 書面評價不自動帶實際差評。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴看候選人的項目履歷很出色，就想省去向初學者解釋步驟的示範；這正是職位需要，而你們還沒觀察。哪個回應最好？

options.en: The application is strong, but we still need to see how she explains a task to beginners.
options.zh: 申請資料很強，但仍需看她怎向初學者解釋任務。

options.en: Her completed projects should be enough to assess beginner explanations without seeing her teach.
options.zh: 她完成的項目應足以評估向初學者解釋，不用看她教。

options.en: Ask for another general certificate instead of a demonstration of the explanation this role needs.
options.zh: 另要一張一般證書，代替示範這職位需要的解釋方法。

dialogue.explanationZh: 履歷優點可保留，但項目及一般證書未直接顯示向初學者解釋的能力，需相關示範。

speaking.en: She looks brilliant on paper, but we still need to see the part of the role that the application cannot show.
speaking.zh: 她履歷看來很出色，但仍需看申請資料不能展示的職責部分。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再保留書面印象與觀察。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友因另一候選人的履歷很亮眼，想在面試前就放棄自己的申請；實際兩人示範尚未進行。你想鼓勵他承認對方書面優勢，但別把它當結果已定，並帶自己的具體作品去。用一至兩句英文回應。
writing.selfCheckZh: 承認另一人書面出色但示範未做，鼓勵準備自己的例子，不把書面優勢變對方必勝或實際能力差。

examples.en: The other candidate may be brilliant on paper, but neither demonstration has happened yet. Bring your own examples rather than treat the result as already decided.
examples.zh: 另一候選人履歷可能很出色，但兩人的示範都還未進行；帶自己的例子，不把結果當已定。

examples.en: Someone can look brilliant on paper without that settling how the interview will go. You can still show the work you have done and explain your approach.
examples.zh: 一個人可履歷看來很出色，但不會因此確定面試結果；你仍可展示已做作品並解釋做法。

takeaways.en: He was brilliant on paper, and the trial gave us a chance to see how he handled the real task.
takeaways.zh: 他履歷很出色，試行給我們機會看他怎處理實際任務。

takeaways.en: A person who looks brilliant on paper may still need support with an unfamiliar part of the job.
takeaways.zh: 履歷看來很出色的人，仍可能在陌生工作部分需支援。

titleZh: 贏得喜愛或支持

brief.meaningEn: Gain people’s affection, goodwill or loyalty.
brief.meaningZh: 得到大家的喜愛、善意或忠誠支持。
brief.grammar: win hearts; win their/our hearts; won in past; explain the action or quality that drew goodwill.
brief.register: Established heart metaphor. It is distinct from winning an award, proving factual accuracy or receiving unanimous agreement.
brief.boundaryZh: 受喜愛不表示每人都認同每項決定、正式獲獎或問題全解；需指出情感支持的依據。
brief.misconceptionZh: 親切行動可得到好感，同時仍需核實資訊及聽不同意見。
brief.outcomeZh: 能自然稱讚贏得好感的行動，保留評價範圍。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Patient teachers often win hearts before they win awards.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 29, table 1, row 5; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The new guide won our hearts by remembering the children’s questions and returning to them at the end, even though some of us still disagreed with the route she chose.
listening.zh: 新導賞員記得孩子問題，結尾再回應，贏得我們喜愛，雖然有些人仍不同意她選的路線。
listening.promptZh: 贏得好感的依據及保留是甚麼？

options.en: She took the children’s questions seriously, while disagreement about the route remained.
options.zh: 她認真對待孩子問題，但路線分歧仍在。

options.en: Everyone approved the route without reservation.
options.zh: 大家毫無保留贊同路線。

options.en: A judging panel gave her the tour’s official first prize.
options.zh: 評判團頒她導賞正式首獎。

options.en: She gained goodwill mainly by choosing the shortest route, rather than by returning to the questions.
options.zh: 她主要因選最短路線得到好感，而非再回應問題。

listening.explanationZh: 回到孩子問題帶好感，even though保留不同意，不是全同意或得獎。

reply.promptZh: 導賞員為甚麼贏得你們好感？
reply.promptEn: Why did the guide gain your goodwill?

options.en: She remembered the children’s questions and answered them later.
options.zh: 她記得孩子問題，稍後回答。

options.en: She won our hearts by showing the children that their questions mattered.
options.zh: 她讓孩子知道問題重要，贏得我們喜愛。

options.en: Her attentive response made the group feel welcome.
options.zh: 她細心回應讓小組感到受歡迎。

options.en: We appreciated that she returned to the questions instead of forgetting them.
options.zh: 我們欣賞她再回問題，不是忘掉。

reply.explanationZh: 四句給關注孩子的具體原因，不把好感當路線全獲同意。

scene.promptZh: 一位故事角色原本冷淡，後來默默為同伴修好舊玩偶，觀眾開始喜歡他，但仍批評他先前說謊。哪句貼切？

options.en: He wins hearts through the caring gesture, without making the earlier lie acceptable.
options.zh: 他透過關懷行動贏得喜愛，沒有令先前謊言變可接受。

options.en: The audience now considers the earlier lie justified simply because they like him.
options.zh: 觀眾只因喜歡他，現認為先前謊言合理。

options.en: The audience values the repair mainly as an attempt to win public recognition, rather than a quiet act of care.
options.zh: 觀眾主要把修補看作爭取公眾認同的嘗試，而非默默關懷。

scene.explanationZh: 默默修玩偶的關懷使觀眾喜歡角色，未表示他在爭公眾認同，也未令先前謊言變合理。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 won hearts 得出？

options.en: People felt affection or goodwill towards the person.
options.zh: 大家對當事人有喜愛或善意。

options.en: Every decision the person makes has been approved.
options.zh: 當事人每個決定都獲批准。

options.en: Context can show what inspired the positive response.
options.zh: 情境可交代甚麼引起正面回應。

contrast.explanationZh: 情感支持不是每項決定的全面同意。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說大家喜歡導賞員，所以路線就不用再聽意見；你們仍有不同看法。哪句最好？

options.en: We can value her care and still discuss whether the route worked for everyone.
options.zh: 可重視她的關懷，同時討論路線是否合大家。

options.en: Leave the route review until next season because the positive personal feedback seems enough for now.
options.zh: 因對個人的正面回饋看來暫已足夠，把路線檢視留到下季。

options.en: Review only the route’s travel time and leave the children’s questions out of the feedback.
options.zh: 只檢視路線行程時間，把孩子的問題排除於回饋。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可肯定細心照顧，亦應處理仍有的路線分歧；不因好感延後安排評估，也不把關懷部分完全排除。

speaking.en: She won our hearts through the care she showed, even when we did not agree with every choice.
speaking.zh: 她展現的關懷贏得我們喜愛，即使我們沒同意每個選擇。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清好感與全面同意。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你向筆友介紹一位原本不熟的街坊，他每次聚餐都替較安靜的人留說話空間，慢慢讓你們願意再邀他；你們還沒討論他的其他主張。你想具體寫他怎贏得好感，不用正式得獎或全員一致的說法。用一至兩句英文介紹。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以具體留發言空間說好感及再邀意願，不把情感支持變正式獎項或全部主張已獲贊同。

examples.en: He has won our hearts by making room for the quieter guests to speak at dinner. That care is why we want to invite him again, not a vote on every view he holds.
examples.zh: 他飯聚時給較安靜來賓說話空間，贏得我們喜愛；這關懷是想再邀他的理由，不是對他每項看法投票。

examples.en: He wins hearts through the small attention he gives to people who are easily overlooked. At our dinners, he waits and invites the quieter voices into the conversation.
examples.zh: 他關注容易被忽略的人，贏得好感；飯聚時，他會等，並邀較安靜者加入談話。

takeaways.en: The character won hearts by returning to help someone who had been left behind.
takeaways.zh: 角色回去幫被落下的人，贏得喜愛。

takeaways.en: Her patient welcome can win hearts without settling every practical question about the event.
takeaways.zh: 她耐心接待可贏好感，卻不會解決活動每項實際問題。

titleZh: 領導賴以運作的重要資源

brief.meaningEn: A quality treated as a central resource that enables leadership to work.
brief.meaningZh: 被視為讓帶領工作可運作的核心資源或特質。
brief.grammar: trust/credibility is the currency of leadership; currency is a metaphor for something that gives influence or enables cooperation.
brief.register: Productive resource metaphor, not a literal financial currency or an objective formula that identifies the only quality a leader needs.
brief.boundaryZh: 指重要作用，不是可買賣的貨幣、領導頭銜或成果保證；需解釋這特質如何幫合作。
brief.misconceptionZh: 信任可支持帶領，仍需能力、資訊及實際安排，不由一句比喻推唯一原因。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體合作情況解釋重要領導資源。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Trust is the currency of leadership in a crisis.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 29, table 1, row 6; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: Trust became the currency of leadership during the project change: people shared their worries with Amira because she explained what she knew and admitted what was still undecided.
listening.zh: 項目改變時，信任成為領導的核心資源：大家願向阿米拉說擔心，因她解釋已知，也承認未定。
listening.promptZh: 比喻以甚麼具體行動支持？

options.en: Her openness made people willing to share concerns and cooperate.
options.zh: 她的坦誠讓大家願分享顧慮並合作。

options.en: Her formal appointment, rather than her openness, was given as the reason people shared concerns.
options.zh: 大家分享顧慮的原因被說成是她正式獲委任，而非坦誠。

options.en: She gained trust by announcing that every decision was final.
options.zh: 她宣布每個決定已定，因而得信任。

options.en: The team kept its concerns private because she refused to discuss uncertainty.
options.zh: 她拒談未知，所以團隊不說顧慮。

listening.explanationZh: 說明已知承認未定支持信任及願說顧慮，不是只靠職位或假定全已定。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼說信任支持她的帶領？
reply.promptEn: Why do you say trust supported her leadership?

options.en: People were willing to share worries because she was open about the situation.
options.zh: 她坦誠交代情況，所以大家願說擔心。

options.en: Trust was the currency of leadership: her honesty made cooperation possible.
options.zh: 信任是領導的重要資源；她的誠實讓合作成為可能。

options.en: Her explanations gave people a reason to speak up rather than hide their concerns.
options.zh: 她的解釋讓大家有理由說出顧慮，不是藏着。

options.en: The group could work with her because she distinguished known facts from open decisions.
options.zh: 她分清已知事實及未定決定，所以小組可與她合作。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給信任如何支援合作的理由。

scene.promptZh: 隊長犯錯後主動說明並邀大家核資料，成員因此願交真實進度，不再只報好消息；你想把可信度視為帶領資源之一。哪句貼切？

options.en: Credibility is the currency of leadership here, helping the team share accurate progress.
options.zh: 這裏可信度是領導的重要資源，幫團隊分享準確進度。

options.en: The title alone has replaced the need for honest progress reports.
options.zh: 頭銜本身已取代誠實進度報告的需要。

options.en: The team’s confidence comes from the captain refusing to acknowledge the mistake.
options.zh: 團隊信心來自隊長拒承認錯誤。

scene.explanationZh: 承認及核實促成真實進度，說明可信度作用，不是頭銜代資料或拒認錯。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 the currency of leadership 得出？

options.en: A quality is being treated as especially useful for leading cooperation.
options.zh: 某特質被視為帶領合作特別有用。

options.en: Trust alone has guaranteed agreement on the new plan.
options.zh: 單憑信任已保證大家同意新計劃。

options.en: The practical role of the named quality still needs explanation.
options.zh: 所指特質的實際作用仍需解釋。

contrast.explanationZh: 重要資源不等於單憑它已取得計劃共識，仍需實際討論及決定。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說信任重要，所以其他能力與安排不用考慮；你只說信任幫大家願意開口。哪句最好？

options.en: Trust helps people cooperate, but it does not replace the skills and arrangements the project needs.
options.zh: 信任幫人合作，但不取代項目所需技巧及安排。

options.en: Once the group trusts someone, planning can be left out of the leadership role.
options.zh: 小組信某人後，帶領角色便可省規劃。

options.en: Focus the next planning meeting only on demonstrating technical skills, and leave no time for people’s concerns.
options.zh: 下次規劃會只集中展示技術，不留時間聽大家顧慮。

dialogue.explanationZh: 信任與實際規劃都重要；不能因有信任省規劃，也不應只展示技術而不聽顧慮。

speaking.en: Trust is the currency of leadership when people need reasons to speak openly and work together.
speaking.zh: 大家需理由坦誠說話並合作時，信任是領導的重要資源。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再解釋資源比喻的實際作用。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩組因借工具的安排僵住，你想提名曾按時歸還、說到做到的同伴做協調人。大家願先聽她，並非因她頭銜高；你想在提名訊息解釋信任怎支持協調，仍請各組共同定借用規則。用一至兩句英文提名。

examples.en: Trust is the currency of leadership, and Mei has earned it by keeping her promises about shared tools. I would nominate her to help the two groups agree on the borrowing rules, not to impose them alone.
examples.zh: 信任是領導的重要資源，美按共用工具承諾行事而贏得信任；我提名她幫兩組議借用規則，不是獨自強加。

examples.en: I would ask Mei to mediate because people know she follows through on small commitments. Trust is the currency of leadership here, while both groups should still take part in setting the rules.
examples.zh: 我會請美協調，因大家知道她會履行小承諾；信任在這裏是領導的重要資源，而兩組仍應參與訂規則。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以守借用承諾支持提名及願聆聽的信任，保留兩組共同訂規則，不把信任變獨斷權或協議保證。

takeaways.en: Credibility was the currency of leadership when the team needed to believe that difficult updates would be explained.
takeaways.zh: 團隊需要相信困難更新會獲解釋時，可信度是領導的重要資源。

takeaways.en: She treated trust as the currency of leadership by keeping her promises and admitting what she could not yet confirm.
takeaways.zh: 她守承諾並承認未能確認之處，把信任視為領導的重要資源。

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

titleZh: 仗勢壓人，濫用權威

brief.meaningEn: Use authority or influence in a domineering or aggressive way.
brief.meaningZh: 以霸道或咄咄逼人的方式使用權力或影響。
brief.grammar: throw your/their weight around; threw/has thrown; possessive matches the person or organisation exerting authority.
brief.register: Disapproving established physical-weight metaphor. Firmly explaining a justified decision is not by itself this behaviour.
brief.boundaryZh: 需有倚權威壓人或擺架子的行為，不只音量大、體型大或有人作決定；要看實際對待方式。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可以清楚訂時限及解釋理由，同時聽相關顧慮，不需以威嚇證明領導。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分合理明確帶領與霸道權威。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A manager who is throwing their weight around can damage trust.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 29, table 1, row 7; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The new chair began throwing his weight around, cutting off questions with “I am in charge” instead of explaining why he wanted the schedule changed.
listening.zh: 新主席開始仗勢壓人，用「我話事」打斷提問，不解釋為何想改時間表。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持負面權威評價？

options.en: He used his title to shut down questions rather than explain the change.
options.zh: 他用頭銜壓下問題，不解釋改動。

options.en: He gave the reasons and invited questions before deciding.
options.zh: 他決定前交代理由並邀提問。

options.en: He spoke quietly because someone else held the decision-making role.
options.zh: 別人才有決策角色，所以他小聲說話。

options.en: He had already accepted the team’s preferred unchanged schedule.
options.zh: 他已接受團隊較喜歡的不變時間表。

listening.explanationZh: 以自己話事截問顯霸道，不是只因他有職位或作決定。

reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼認為新主席仗勢壓人？
reply.promptEn: Why do you see the new chair as domineering?

options.en: He stopped questions by referring only to his authority.
options.zh: 他只提權力便阻問題。

options.en: He was throwing his weight around rather than explaining the schedule change.
options.zh: 他仗勢壓人，不解釋時間改動。

options.en: His response to concerns was “I am in charge,” not a reason.
options.zh: 他回顧慮是「我話事」，不是理由。

options.en: He used the chair’s position to end discussion before people understood the proposal.
options.zh: 他用主席職位，在大家明白提案前結束討論。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給具體權威壓人的行為，不評體型。

scene.promptZh: 組長說「我有權就不用解釋」，用退隊威脅讓人接受與工作無關的私人要求；你想描述這種仗權威的做法。哪句貼切？

options.en: The leader is throwing their weight around to get people to accept the personal request.
options.zh: 組長在仗勢壓人，要大家接受私人要求。

options.en: The leader is calmly explaining a shared rule and hearing relevant concerns.
options.zh: 組長正冷靜解釋共同規則，聽相關顧慮。

options.en: The leader has no influence over the people receiving the request.
options.zh: 組長對收到要求的人毫無影響力。

scene.explanationZh: 以角色威脅私人要求支持霸道評價，不是合理說明或沒影響力。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像 throwing their weight around？

options.en: Use a position of power to silence reasonable questions.
options.zh: 利用權力地位壓下合理問題。

options.en: Explain a clear deadline and invite practical concerns about meeting it.
options.zh: 解釋清楚期限，邀提出達成的實際顧慮。

options.en: Make unrelated demands while threatening consequences for disagreement.
options.zh: 以不同意就有後果作威脅，提出無關要求。

contrast.explanationZh: 明確規則配合理聆聽，不等於霸道用權。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說「只要組長給時限，就是仗勢壓人」，但這次已解釋共同需要，也聽問題。哪句最好？

options.en: Look at how the authority is used; a reasoned deadline is different from silencing people with a title.
options.zh: 看權力怎用；有理由的期限不同於靠頭銜壓人。

options.en: Any deadline from a leader should be treated as proof of aggressive authority.
options.zh: 任何領導給的期限都應當霸道權威的證據。

options.en: Keep the deadline, but close further practical questions because the leader has already explained the reason.
options.zh: 保留期限，但因領導已解釋理由，就停止再問實務問題。

dialogue.explanationZh: 按權力使用方式評價，合理期限不自動是壓人；已給理由也不等於應拒絕相關實務問題。

speaking.en: He was throwing his weight around instead of giving people a reason they could discuss.
speaking.zh: 他在仗勢壓人，不給大家可討論的理由。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出權威怎被使用。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友主持合作錄音，只因另一人要求重聽一句，便說自己資歷最深、拒絕所有解釋。你想私下寫訊息指出這次做法像仗勢壓人，提議改為說明取捨並一起重聽，不評他整個人格。用一至兩句英文回應。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指向用資歷壓下重聽問題的具體做法，提議解釋及共同聽，不以單次行為全盤定人格或否定所有帶領權責。

examples.en: Saying your experience ends the question sounds like throwing your weight around. Could we explain the trade-off and listen to that line together instead?
examples.zh: 說你的資歷可結束問題，聽來像仗勢壓人；可否改為解釋取捨，一起重聽那句？

examples.en: I felt you were throwing your weight around when you used seniority to stop the discussion. I would rather hear the reason for keeping the line and check it with everyone.
examples.zh: 你用資歷止討論時，我覺得你在仗勢壓人；我寧願聽保留那句的理由，再跟大家核。

glossary.en: the reason for keeping the line

takeaways.en: The manager threw his weight around by demanding agreement without explaining the change.
takeaways.zh: 經理要求同意卻不解釋改動，仗勢壓人。

takeaways.en: She can lead firmly without throwing her weight around when she explains the reasons and hears concerns.
takeaways.zh: 她解釋原因並聽顧慮時，可堅定帶領而不仗勢壓人。

titleZh: 落後於應有進度或步伐

brief.meaningEn: Fail to keep up with an expected pace, schedule or another group’s progress.
brief.meaningZh: 未能跟上預期步伐、時間表或另一群體進度。
brief.grammar: fall behind with work; fall behind schedule; fall behind the group; fell/has fallen behind.
brief.register: Common phrasal verb for relative progress. Being behind does not itself mean complete failure, lack of ability or impossibility of catching up.
brief.boundaryZh: 需有比較進度或步伐；落後可局部暫時，不等於整體全敗，也不自動知道原因。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可指出哪部分落後並找可行下一步，不由比較直接推動機或能力。
brief.outcomeZh: 能精確交代相對進度及需要協調的部分。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Learners may fall behind without timely help.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 29, table 1, row 8; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: We fell behind with cataloguing the new boxes when two volunteers were away, but the older collection remained available; we needed to revise the new-box timetable rather than close the whole archive.
listening.zh: 兩義工不在時，新箱編目落後，但舊收藏仍可用；我們需改新箱時間表，不是關整個檔案庫。
listening.promptZh: 哪部分落後，哪部分仍可用？

options.en: New-box cataloguing lagged, while the older collection remained accessible.
options.zh: 新箱編目落後，舊收藏仍可使用。

options.en: The entire archive had become inaccessible because every record was unfinished.
options.zh: 每項紀錄未完，所以整個檔案庫不能用。

options.en: The new boxes were catalogued ahead of the revised timetable.
options.zh: 新箱編目比改後時間表提前。

options.en: The older collection was the only work left unfinished before the volunteers went away.
options.zh: 義工離開前，只有舊收藏仍未做。

listening.explanationZh: 落後限新箱，舊收藏仍可用，需調局部進度。

reply.promptZh: 兩義工不在時，編目進度怎樣？
reply.promptEn: What happened to the cataloguing when two volunteers were away?

options.en: The new boxes took longer than planned, while the older collection stayed open.
options.zh: 新箱比計劃慢，舊收藏仍開放。

options.en: We fell behind with the new boxes and needed to revise their timetable.
options.zh: 我們新箱進度落後，需改其時間表。

options.en: The backlog concerned the incoming material, not access to all existing records.
options.zh: 積壓關新入材料，不是全部舊紀錄的使用。

options.en: We could not maintain the planned pace for the additional boxes.
options.zh: 我們未能維持新增箱的原定步伐。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都交代局部進度，不擴成全庫失效。

scene.promptZh: 步行小組在上坡加快，你為等同伴繫鞋帶，現在跟大隊隔了一段，仍沿同路前進。哪句準確？

options.en: We have fallen behind the main group while staying on the same route.
options.zh: 我們仍在同路前進，但落在大隊後面。

options.en: We have taken a different route and reached the end before the main group.
options.zh: 我們走另路，較大隊先到終點。

options.en: We are now moving at the group’s pace, so we are no longer any distance behind it.
options.zh: 我們現跟大隊同速，所以已沒有任何距離落在後面。

scene.explanationZh: 同路前進仍可有相對距離；速度一樣不會自動消除已形成的落後，也不是改路先到。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 fallen behind 得出？

options.en: Progress or position is behind a relevant comparison.
options.zh: 進度或位置落後相關比較。

options.en: The delay establishes that the person lacks the ability for the whole course.
options.zh: 延誤確立當事人缺乏整個課程所需能力。

options.en: Context should identify the pace or schedule being compared.
options.zh: 情境應指出比較哪步伐或日程。

contrast.explanationZh: 目前相對進度未確立整體能力不足，原因及後續支援仍需看情境。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說新箱慢了就應宣布整庫不能用，但舊收藏照常。哪句最好？

options.en: Report the new-box delay separately from the older collection that people can still use.
options.zh: 把新箱延誤與仍可用的舊收藏分開報。

options.en: Concentrate only on the open collection and leave the growing new-box backlog out of the timetable review.
options.zh: 只集中已開放收藏，把增加的新箱積壓排除於日程檢視。

options.en: Keep the original new-box deadline unchanged and review it only after it has passed.
options.zh: 維持新箱原限期不變，到過期後才檢視。

dialogue.explanationZh: 舊收藏照常與新箱落後需各自說明，並及時檢視新箱進度；不能因舊服務仍開就忽略積壓或等過期才看。

speaking.en: We have fallen behind with one part of the work, so we need to check its schedule without treating everything as a failure.
speaking.zh: 我們一部分工作落後，所以需核該部分時間表，不把一切當失敗。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再說明相對進度的範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你與朋友共讀長篇小說，忙一周後你只到第五章，朋友已到第八章，今晚想談結尾。你要有禮承認共讀進度落後，請暫不透露後文，可先談你已讀的部分，再約補上後討論。用一至兩句英文發訊息。
writing.selfCheckZh: 給第五章對第八章的相對進度，提出先談已讀及延後結尾，不把落後當不再想讀或已知後文。

examples.en: I have fallen behind with the novel and am only at chapter five. Could we discuss that part tonight without spoilers, then return to the ending after I catch up?
examples.zh: 我小說進度落後，只到第五章；今晚可否先談那部分、不透露後文，待我追上再談結尾？

examples.en: I fell behind during a busy week, so I have not reached your chapter yet. Please save the later plot for our next conversation, and we can talk about the first five chapters now.
examples.zh: 忙一周時我落後了，還未到你讀的章；請把後面情節留下次談，現在可談前五章。

takeaways.en: The team fell behind schedule after the extra checking took longer than expected.
takeaways.zh: 額外核對比預期久後，團隊進度落後時間表。

takeaways.en: She asked which topic to review first after falling behind with the lessons.
takeaways.zh: 課程進度落後後，她問應先溫哪個主題。

titleZh: 讓人或場面冷靜下來

brief.meaningEn: Help people become less anxious, upset or agitated, or reduce tension in a situation.
brief.meaningZh: 幫人減少焦慮、不快或激動，也可指讓某個場面的緊張程度減低。
brief.grammar: calm the team down; calm them down; pronoun goes between calm and down; calmed in past. Calm things down refers to reducing tension in the situation, often among a group; things supplies the contextual situation rather than a new literal-object sense. Trying to do so does not establish a successful result.
brief.register: Natural separable phrasal verb. A calmer response is not a guarantee that the underlying problem is solved or everyone agrees.
brief.boundaryZh: 冷靜程度可逐漸改，不等於沒有合理顧慮或問題已完；需看提供了甚麼實際幫助。
brief.misconceptionZh: 讓人平靜不應寫成壓下所有問題；可以冷靜後繼續查及討論。
brief.outcomeZh: 能具體描述情緒舒緩及仍需處理的問題。

sources.sentence: A clear update can calm the team down.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 29, table 1, row 9; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

sources.sentence: The manager tried to calm things down.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page 262, table 2, row 6.

listening.en: The clear update calmed the team down: the venue had not cancelled, it had only changed the entrance, and we still needed to tell the arriving guests where to go.
listening.zh: 清楚更新讓團隊冷靜下來：場地沒取消，只改入口；我們仍需告訴抵達來賓去哪。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼令人較平靜，甚麼仍待做？

options.en: They learned the venue was still available, but guests still needed the new entrance details.
options.zh: 得知場地仍可用，但來賓仍需新入口資料。

options.en: The venue had cancelled and all guests had already received refunds.
options.zh: 場地已取消，所有來賓已收退款。

options.en: The calmer team had already told every guest about the entrance.
options.zh: 團隊較平靜時，已告訴每位來賓入口。

options.en: The update gave no location information and only asked the team not to speak.
options.zh: 更新沒地點資料，只叫團隊別說話。

listening.explanationZh: 澄清非取消帶平靜，入口通知仍要做；不是全處理完或只壓發言。

reply.promptZh: 那段更新怎樣幫團隊？
reply.promptEn: How did the update help the team?

options.en: It explained that the venue was still available despite the entrance change.
options.zh: 它解釋入口雖改，場地仍可用。

options.en: It calmed the team down by explaining that the venue remained available despite the changed entrance.
options.zh: 它解釋入口雖改、場地仍可用，讓團隊冷靜下來。

options.en: People felt less anxious once they understood what had actually changed.
options.zh: 明白實際改了甚麼後，大家較不焦慮。

options.en: The information reduced confusion without completing the guest notification.
options.zh: 資料減混亂，但來賓通知仍未完成。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答資訊如何減焦慮，未把通知當已完。

scene.promptZh: 排練時兩組因同時要舞台而激動，統籌請各組輪流說需要，再一起看可用時段，大家聲音漸低；尚未議定。哪句貼切？

options.en: The discussion is helping calm the team down, although the times are not settled yet.
options.zh: 討論正幫團隊冷靜下來，雖時間仍未定。

options.en: The quieter voices confirm that both groups have accepted a final schedule.
options.zh: 聲音較低確認兩組已接受最後時間表。

options.en: The coordinator cancelled both groups’ chance to explain their needs.
options.zh: 統籌取消兩組解釋需要的機會。

scene.explanationZh: 輪流聽與看選項使聲音漸低，不是協議已定或不准說。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 calmed the team down 得出？

options.en: The group became less anxious or agitated.
options.zh: 小組較不焦慮或激動。

options.en: Every issue causing the upset has been resolved.
options.zh: 造成不快的每項問題都已解決。

options.en: Context can show whether a practical discussion still remains.
options.zh: 情境可顯示是否仍需實際討論。

contrast.explanationZh: 情緒變化不自動解決根源。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說大家平靜了，就不用通知來賓新入口；你知來賓仍未收到。哪句最好？

options.en: The update helped our team, but the guests still need the correct entrance information.
options.zh: 更新幫了團隊，但來賓仍需正確入口資料。

options.en: All guests have already received the new entrance details, so only the team’s feelings still need attention.
options.zh: 所有來賓已收新入口資料，所以只需再照顧團隊感受。

options.en: Our next message should reassure the team again rather than tell guests where to enter.
options.zh: 下段訊息應再安慰團隊，而非告訴來賓從哪進。

dialogue.explanationZh: 團隊已較平靜，但來賓仍需入口資料；不能誤報已通知，或繼續只顧內部安慰而漏對外安排。

speaking.en: The explanation calmed them down, but we still needed to act on the concern they had raised.
speaking.zh: 解釋讓他們冷靜下來，但仍需處理他們提出的顧慮。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清情緒與實際處理。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：小組要在公開活動分享第一次作品，大家怕答不出觀眾問題，越想越急。你知道熟悉的導師願在開場前陪練一次；想寫訊息請組長邀她來，先練怎樣坦白說不確定，再請她幫大家慢慢試開場，不替全組保證成功。用一至兩句英文請求。

examples.en: Could we ask our tutor to help calm the team down before the public session by practising how to answer a question we are unsure about? A short run-through of the opening may help us feel ready without pretending we know every answer.
examples.zh: 可否請導師在公開活動前，幫練怎回答不確定的問題，讓團隊冷靜下來？短試開場可幫我們有準備感，不假裝知道每個答案。

examples.en: I think a practice with someone we trust could calm the team down before we present our first work. Could you invite the tutor to help us rehearse a slow opening and an honest response to an unfamiliar question?
examples.zh: 我想跟信任的人練習，可在展示首件作品前讓團隊冷靜；可否邀導師幫排慢一點的開場，及誠實回應不熟悉問題？

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出請熟悉導師陪練不確定問題及慢開場的具體支援，保留試行及未來結果，不保證全懂或成功。

takeaways.en: The organiser calmed the group down by explaining what had changed and what remained secure.
takeaways.zh: 主辦者解釋改了甚麼及甚麼仍穩妥，讓小組冷靜。

takeaways.en: We can calm them down without dismissing the questions they still need answered.
takeaways.zh: 我們可讓他們冷靜下來，同時不否定他們仍需答案的問題。

titleZh: 處於朝目標推進的軌道上

brief.meaningEn: In a position or direction that is progressing towards an intended result.
brief.meaningZh: 處於正朝原定結果推進的位置或方向。
brief.grammar: be on course for + noun/to + verb; keep a project on course; a status frame, related to stay on course, which emphasises maintaining direction.
brief.register: Established navigation metaphor. It describes a current prospect or direction rather than an already achieved result.
brief.boundaryZh: 目前朝目標推進不等於已完成或保證期限不改；需有進度證據，並可有仍待做的部分。
brief.misconceptionZh: 少量待辦不一定令目標失去可能，也不能只因樂觀語氣就斷定進度合適。
brief.outcomeZh: 能按實際進度描述目前位置及仍待確認的結果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Regular reviews can keep the project on course.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 29, table 1, row 10; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: With the interviews complete and the first edit checked, the series was on course for a Friday release, although the final sound check still had to be done.
listening.zh: 訪問完成、初剪核過後，系列目前朝周五發布推進，雖最後聲音核對仍需做。
listening.promptZh: 目前進度及未完部分是甚麼？

options.en: Completed stages supported Friday as a current prospect, with the sound check still pending.
options.zh: 已完階段支持目前可望周五發布，聲音核對仍待做。

options.en: The series had already been released with its sound fully checked.
options.zh: 系列已發布，聲音全核過。

options.en: No interview had been completed, so editing had not begun.
options.zh: 沒訪問完成，所以剪輯未開始。

options.en: Friday had been rejected and replaced by an agreed later date.
options.zh: 周五已被否決，另有議定較後日期。

listening.explanationZh: 已完訪問初剪支持目前方向，仍待最後聲音核，不是已發布或已改日。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼目前仍可望周五發布？
reply.promptEn: Why is a Friday release still a realistic prospect?

options.en: The interviews and checked first edit are complete.
options.zh: 訪問及核過的初剪已完成。

options.en: Those completed stages put us on course for Friday, pending the final sound check.
options.zh: 那些已完階段讓我們目前朝周五推進，仍待最後聲音核。

options.en: Only the final sound check remains from the stages mentioned.
options.zh: 所提階段只餘最後聲音核。

options.en: The progress already made supports the planned date, without making it a finished release.
options.zh: 已有進度支持原定日，但不表示已發布。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給目前進度依據，保留最後核對。

scene.promptZh: 同學想月底完成三段故事，現已核兩段，第三段草稿已有且有兩次修改時段，老師說目前方向合適，不是已交完成稿。哪句準確？

options.en: She is on course to finish by the end of the month, with revision still to do.
options.zh: 她目前朝月底完成推進，仍需修改。

options.en: The teacher has already accepted three finished sections.
options.zh: 老師已收三段完成稿。

options.en: The current plan has no time left for revising the third draft.
options.zh: 目前計劃已沒時間修第三段草稿。

scene.explanationZh: 已有進度及修改時段支持目前可望完成，未變已交或沒時段。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 on course for completion 得出？

options.en: The current position supports progress towards completion.
options.zh: 目前位置支持朝完成推進。

options.en: The finished result has already been delivered.
options.zh: 完成成果已交付。

options.en: The remaining steps and evidence still matter.
options.zh: 剩餘步驟及證據仍重要。

contrast.explanationZh: 朝完成不等於完成已交。

dialogue.promptZh: 系列目前可望周五發布，但最後聲音核對仍未做，同伴想把原留給核對的時段全用來宣傳。哪個回應最好？

options.en: The Friday release still looks achievable, provided we keep time for the final sound check.
options.zh: 周五發布仍看來可達成，前提是保留最後聲音核對時間。

options.en: Use the remaining slot for promotion and leave the sound check until after release.
options.zh: 把餘下時段用來宣傳，聲音核對留發布後。

options.en: Announce a later release now without first reviewing the time the remaining check needs.
options.zh: 未檢視餘下核對所需時間，現在就宣布延期。

dialogue.explanationZh: 目前可望有賴餘下工作照計劃完成；應留核對時間，不把它移到發布後，也不未估便延期。

speaking.en: We are on course to finish, but the remaining checks are still part of getting there.
speaking.zh: 我們目前朝完成推進，但餘下核對仍是到達目標的一部分。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再保留當前進度與未完部分。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友擔心你們的手作禮物趕不及生日，實際主體已完成，只餘包裝及寫卡，已約明晚一起做。你想以這些進度安慰他目前可望趕上，但不說已把禮物交出去。用一至兩句英文回覆。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以主體已完及明晚已約說當前可望，保留包裝卡及未交付，不靠空泛樂觀或把日程當結果。

examples.en: We are on course to have the gift ready for the birthday: the main piece is finished, and we have tomorrow evening for wrapping and the card. It has not been delivered yet, but the remaining work has a time slot.
examples.zh: 我們目前可望生日備好禮物：主體完成，明晚有時間包裝寫卡；尚未送出，但餘下工作有時段。

examples.en: The finished piece puts us on course for the birthday, with wrapping and a card still to do. Let us keep our plan for tomorrow evening rather than assume everything is already ready.
examples.zh: 已完成主體讓我們目前朝生日推進，仍需包裝寫卡；保留明晚安排，不假定全部已好。

takeaways.en: The checked draft put the team on course for the next stage, although the final approval was still pending.
takeaways.zh: 核過草稿讓團隊目前朝下階段推進，雖最後批准仍待定。

takeaways.en: We are on course to meet the agreed date if the remaining trial goes as planned.
takeaways.zh: 若餘下試行按計劃，目前可望達到議定日期。
